title: Shape a Real Article Outline
prompt:
Write the heading structure of a short article — not six empty heading tags, but a real outline: one `h1` for the article title, two `h2` section headings, and one `h3` sub-heading under the first section. Add one short paragraph under each heading so the structure has content.

Rules:
- Exactly one `h1`.
- At least two `h2` elements.
- At least one `h3` after the first `h2`.
- Every heading is followed by a paragraph.
boilerplate: <!-- Article: 'A Week of Learning' — build the heading outline -->

tests.name: exactly one h1
tests.hint: Use <h1> once, for the article title only.

tests.name: at least two h2 sections
tests.hint: Give the article two sections, each introduced by an <h2>.

tests.name: an h3 nests under the first section
tests.hint: <h3> is a sub-heading: put it after an <h2>, never before the first one.

tests.name: every heading is followed by a paragraph
tests.hint:
After each heading, write a short

with a sentence of content.
